decision: The completed seed 1025 was frozen before dynamics and serves as the first development test. Confirm the fixed official policy with a second prospectively fixed development seed. Use the new heldout seed only after both development tests meet the post-forward action and raw constraint agreement gates. Record cached scores as historical comparators under identical action requirements.
policy_scope: Read-only scoring and diagnostic force capture on the same physical trajectories. Keep the original policy, observations, solver, reward, motion criteria and full first-episode recording. Report post-forward and legacy results separately.
